annotations.title: Look up papers by PMID or DOI

description: Looks up papers in the RBAi Scholar corpus by PubMed ID or DOI, up to 50 per call. Returns each paper found with its title, authors, year, journal, abstract, DOI, PMID, citation count and open-access status, and lists the identifiers that are not in the corpus.

format.description: Leave out for the readable list. "ris" (imports into Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote) or "bibtex" (Zotero, Mendeley, LaTeX): the same papers as a citation file, returned as the result text. "json": the papers as JSON records (optional)

ids.description: PubMed IDs (e.g. "21376230") or DOIs (e.g. "10.1016/j.cell.2011.02.013", in any case, with or without https://doi.org/), up to 50.

name: get_papers
title: Look up papers by PMID or DOI
